svg.title: ChickenWings-0: GitHub activity as a topographic map
svg.desc: Contour map of 451 contributions over the 52 weeks to 2026-11-15. Time runs left to right, each ridge is a repository, height is contributions per week on a log scale. Highest summits: JOC (Apr 2026, 26), SatQuery-AI (Sep 2026, 7), OOPS-PBL (Nov 2026, 26), maitri (May 2026, 12).
svg.text: Relief: contributions per week, log scale
